title: Title
about_text: TUM SafeSignal is the reporting platform of the Technical University of Munich. Members and guests of the university can use it to report problems, misconduct, safety concerns, or other issues to the team responsible for handling them. Pick a topic below, fill in a short form, and your report goes straight to the right people.
